description: Classifies each supplied review date as fresh, aging or stale at the caller's required as-of date. The whole-day age must exceed a threshold to reach the next level. The dataset level is the worst record's level. This measures time since the supplied dates. It cannot tell whether a review happened or whether the data is accurate. As of 2026-08-02T12:00:00Z with thresholds of 14 and 45 days, a 2026-07-20 review is fresh at 13 days and a 2026-06-01 review is stale at 62 days.

staleAfterDays.description: Whole days after which a record becomes stale.

warnAfterDays.description: Whole days after which a record becomes aging.

now.description: Required as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD at UTC midnight) or zoned ISO timestamp with seconds.

records.description: Records with review dates. An empty array has no dates to check.

id.description: Record identifier, echoed in the result.

reviewedOn.description: Review date as YYYY-MM-DD or a zoned ISO timestamp with seconds.

name: check_freshness
title: Check which review dates are overdue
